ITEM 1 | Square white plate (about 26 cm across) with a single irregular patty-like mass of orange-brown food, roughly 9 cm by 7 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, with visible flecks of green and some light-colored bits; surface looks fibrous and slightly moist, with browned edges and a crumbly, jagged outline; sits at the left side of the plate | 130

ITEM 2 | Three thin yellow-green wedge-shaped slices, each about 4 cm long and 1 cm thick, with smooth pale-yellow flesh and a slightly glossy skin edge, arranged in an overlapping cluster in the upper-left corner of the plate, next to the patty | 40
